scope: one-card device mechanism, not TP2PP2/engine readiness

leaves.leaf: two logical rank owners on one SM86 GPU with separate real compute/copy streams
leaves.replaces: TP workers on distinct GPUs/green contexts
leaves.equivalence: More convenient: genuine selection-copy skew and actual per-rank ownership checks; no NCCL/green-context or cross-process proof.

leaves.leaf: serialized bucket execution after genuine two-stream selection agreement
leaves.replaces: concurrent TP layer execution on separate devices
leaves.equivalence: More convenient and required by the unmodified per-device staging-arena cache. Proves each local numerical oracle and lifetime, not concurrent TP execution.

leaves.leaf: small real CUDA tensors, stock Mamba context/LaneChunk and constructed source/module owners
leaves.replaces: full model projections, indexer, scheduler-produced KV allocation and model runner
leaves.equivalence: More convenient reduced geometry; actual staged helper, source allocator/registry, stock state-finalization kernel and Row1Qualifier execute. Supplied legal 4097-row top-k is not model-generated.

leaves.leaf: typed query boundary_op_seq=2 and direct pure profile agreement
leaves.equivalence: More convenient host input; GPU proof uses real queried plans and grant validation. Cached descriptor/idempotent reply/credit coverage is the separate CPU connected proof, not this GPU run.

leaves.leaf: torch.cuda._sleep on one actual copy stream
leaves.replaces: naturally variable rank selection-copy completion time
leaves.equivalence: Intentional device delay; actual event query must show ready/pending or result is INCONCLUSIVE. No event/readiness method patched.

leaves.replaces: device receipt during CPU-shape self-run only
leaves.equivalence: More convenient: exercises positive/negative grading branches, never GPU evidence. Owner GPU run grades its own raw bytes and layer digests.

deferred: TP2PP2 green contexts and multiprocessing timing
full engine healthy request error and ordinary scheduling after hardware mismatch
full native18 row1/row2/row4 and performance gates
